steps.text: Blend chickpeas, tahini, lemon juice, garlic, cumin and salt until crumbly.
steps.cue: The mixture is a thick, crumbly paste with no whole chickpeas left.
steps.tip: Scrape down the sides once so it blends evenly.

steps.text: Add the cold water and oil a little at a time with the blender running, until smooth and pale.
steps.cue: The hummus is smooth and pale and falls from a spoon in a soft ribbon.
steps.tip: Keep the blender running while you add liquid so it turns light and creamy.
